note: Negative case. A friendly call with no new qualification information. Over-extraction here is the real failure mode, since debrief output gets written into deal records.

deal.pain: Sample tracking is manual and error-prone.

transcript:
Helen: Sorry, I've only got ten minutes — the instrument booking ran over.
Us: No problem. Did you get a chance to look at the summary I sent?
Helen: I skimmed it. It looks sensible. I'd want to see it running against our own data before I could say much more.
Us: Happy to arrange that. Anyone else you'd want in the room?
Helen: Let me think about that. Things are a bit unsettled here at the moment. Can we pick it up after the holidays?
Us: Of course. I'll send something over in January.
